text:
jay: Heads up — canary promotion blocked, staging e2e failing after the payments DB migration in commit 0a1b2c. Deploybot held the promotion. Logs show 500s on /payments/charge during integration run. @samir can you take a look?

deploybot: Promotion attempt for canary build canary-20260318-0a1b2c failed checks and is being held. Failure summary: integrations/payment_flow_test 3/3 attempts failed. See CI: https://ci.internal/12345/status :warning:

samir: Reproduced locally against a staging snapshot — queries against payments are timing out, looks like an index change in migration 20260318_add_payments_index altered planner choice and increased scan time. Running: `bazel test //integrations:payment_flow_test --test_output=errors` locally.

micaela: Saw the same. The migration added a covering index but changed column order; with replica lag + planner CBO we get bad plan. Two short options: revert migration (hotfix) or reindex + force planner hints, but reindex could be heavy during change window.

jay: Change window closes 16:00 UTC. Prefer minimal blast radius. Options: 1) revert migration and repromote canary, 2) pin this release to previous good commit and ship other changes later, 3) tolerate delay until we can reindex safely out of window. Thoughts? :eyes:

release-manager: Leaning revert migration + patch release. I'll open the revert PR and coordinate release notes. Also request: pin the promotion to the last-green commit (9f8e7d) until we validate the fix.

deploybot: Pin applied: promotion pinned to commit 9f8e7d per request from release-manager. Holding further promotions for canary-20260318-0a1b2c.

samir: Revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482 — title: "revert: remove 20260318_add_payments_index migration". Triggering CI now. Link to run: https://ci.internal/12345/runs/67890

micaela: Add a short release note bullet in the PR: "Rollback payments index migration — staging e2e failures observed; reintroduce after controlled reindexing and planner verification."

jay: If CI green by 12:30 UTC we can re-promote earlier; otherwise we keep the pin and schedule reattempt in tomorrow's change window. Also capture impact in release notes and notify support.

samir: CI status: failing (flake caused by unrelated timeouts) -> rerun -> CI status: passing.

deploybot: CI check passed for PR 482. Promotion pin will be lifted when release-manager approves re-promotion.

release-manager: Approving revert PR now, will unpin and kick canary re-promotion at 12:40 UTC. I'll also add an item to release notes: "hotfix: revert payments index migration to restore canary stability; follow-up scheduled for safe reindexing."

jay: Thanks all. Follow-up owner: micaela for reindex plan, samir for monitoring. I'll update the changelog and send a short announcement to #general once canary is fully promoted. :thumbsup:
